import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# --- Data Preparation ---
# Combine date and time into a single datetime object to extract the hour
df['datetime'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'] + ' ' + df['time'])
df['hour'] = df['datetime'].dt.hour

# --- Data Aggregation for Heatmap ---
# Create a pivot table to summarize total sales for each product per hour
sales_heatmap_data = df.pivot_table(
    values='total',
    index='product',
    columns='hour',
    aggfunc='sum',
    fill_value=0
)

# Sort products by total daily sales for a more organized and insightful visualization
product_total_sales = sales_heatmap_data.sum(axis=1).sort_values(ascending=False)
sales_heatmap_data = sales_heatmap_data.loc[product_total_sales.index]

# --- Visualization ---
# Set the aesthetic style of the plots
sns.set_theme(style="white", font_scale=1.1)

# Create the figure and axes for the plot
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(20, 10))

# Generate the heatmap
sns.heatmap(
    sales_heatmap_data,
    annot=False,  # Annotations would be too cluttered
    cmap='viridis',
    linewidths=.5,
    linecolor='lightgray',
    ax=ax,
    cbar_kws={'label': 'Total Sales ($)'}
)

# --- Customization and Labeling ---
# Set the title and labels with appropriate font sizes
ax.set_title('Peak Sales Hours by Product', fontsize=22, weight='bold', pad=25)
ax.set_xlabel('Hour of the Day (24-hour format)', fontsize=16, labelpad=20)
ax.set_ylabel('Product', fontsize=16, labelpad=20)

# Improve tick label readability
ax.tick_params(axis='x', labelsize=12)
ax.tick_params(axis='y', rotation=0, labelsize=12)

# Add a subtle grid effect within the heatmap
for i in range(sales_heatmap_data.shape[1] + 1):
    ax.axvline(i, color='lightgray', linewidth=0.5)
for i in range(sales_heatmap_data.shape[0] + 1):
    ax.axhline(i, color='lightgray', linewidth=0.5)

# --- Save the Figure ---
# Save the final visualization to a file
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
